dataset.citation: 5G-QoERA drive-test export (Boffetti et al., IEEE WCNC 2025; telematics-lab/5G-QoERA, GPL-3.0), converted to CSV with throughput and MOS columns; regulatory-compliance task supported by ANATEL RQUAL (Res. 717/2019, operator-funded ESAQ measurement entity), FCC broadband-map misreporting evidence (IMC'24, DOI 10.1145/3646547.3688441), and consent-gated 3GPP MDT (TS 32.422) and standardized QMC (TS 28.405) collection.
dataset.samplingRule: deterministic stride sample: row[i*floor(validRows/16)] for i in 0..15

bs1_3000kbps_compliance_16.indicator: compliance <=> goodCount * 1000 >= n * targetPermille, good <=> mosMilli > poorThresholdMilli
bs1_3000kbps_compliance_16.literatureTask: Periodic regulatory quality indicator (share of sessions meeting target vs. reference value) computed by an operator-funded measurement entity over user measurements collected under consent-gated 3GPP MDT-style machinery; verifiability deters strategic misreporting documented for self-reported regulatory data.

bs1_bs4_3000kbps_regional_16.samplingRule: deterministic stride sample per CSV: row[i*floor(validRows/8)] for i in 0..7, BS_1 sessions first
bs1_bs4_3000kbps_regional_16.cellIndexRule: cellIndex = floor((lat+90)/g)*36000 + floor((lon+180)/g), g = 0.01 degrees (about 1.1 km); non-negative by construction for unsigned lowering
bs1_bs4_3000kbps_regional_16.indicator: regional compliance <=> inRegionCount > 0 and goodInRegionCount * 1000 >= inRegionCount * targetPermille, in <=> cellIndex == targetCell, good <=> mosMilli > poorThresholdMilli; returns zero when inRegionCount == 0
bs1_bs4_3000kbps_regional_16.privacyNote: The encrypted operands are a coarse cell index (about 1.1 km grid) and the milli-MOS per session. The aggregator computes the area-scoped indicator without learning which session lies in the target area. A challenged trace disclosure publishes the trace structure and handle-level provenance, not operand values: the panel's coarse cell indices stay encrypted, the public target cell is a program constant, and raw coordinates never enter any computation.
bs1_bs4_3000kbps_regional_16.literatureTask: Area-scoped periodic quality indicator (share of an area's sessions meeting target vs. reference value, as in per-municipality quality grades) computed over encrypted location cells and encrypted MOS, without revealing session-to-area membership to the aggregator.
